verdict.rationale: Rootly documents alert ingestion from monitoring tools and names Datadog and Sentry as alert sources (rootly-docs-65). It routes alerts across all sources (rootly-docs-10, rootly-docs-37), and its AWS connector lets Rootly AI query CloudWatch metrics (rootly-docs-59, rootly-docs-90), with a general connectors overview for observability tools (rootly-docs-88). Grafana and Prometheus are never named, and no per-tool setup guides are shown. missing for 10: evidence of Grafana and Prometheus integrations, dedicated documented setup steps for the Datadog, Sentry and CloudWatch alert integrations, independent corroboration.
